cases.name: zero-hunk patch throws 'No files were modified.'
multi-op patch (add + update + delete) applies in order

args.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: new.txt
+brand new
*** Update File: keep.txt
@@
-hello
+HELLO
*** Delete File: old.txt
*** End Patch

cases.name: rename reports modified under original path (spec §9.1)

args.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src.txt
*** Move to: dst.txt
@@
-body
+body2
*** End Patch

cases.name: partial success: earlier ops stay applied when a later op fails

args.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: first.txt
@@
-a
+A
*** Update File: missing.txt
@@
-x
+y
*** End Patch

expect.error:
[missing.txt]: File not found: missing.txt
No files were modified — sections apply atomically.

cases.name: applyCodexPatch *** Add File over existing file rejects and preserves content

args.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: hello.txt
+overwritten
*** End Patch

expect.error: Cannot create hello.txt: file already exists. Use *** Update File to modify it in place.

cases.name: applyCodexPatch *** Move to over existing destination rejects and preserves both files

args.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src.txt
*** Move to: dst.txt
@@
-hello
+HELLO
*** End Patch

expect.error: Cannot rename src.txt to dst.txt: destination already exists.

cases.name: apply_patch mode: *** Add File over an existing file still rejects

args.input:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: exists.txt
+replacement
*** End Patch

@@
